pages.title: Expedition Start
pages.text: $(l)Entry 1$(br)$()No one said delving into the 9 hells, buried deep beneath the bedrock layer, was particularly easy, let alone finding a rare, glistening metal engraved into the hellish brimstone - but you start to do such crazy things after trying to $(k)communicate with literal gods,$() or even just trying to find their $(k)offspring or next of kin.

$(l)Entry 2$(br)$()It's intriguing just how confident one is before taking on such an incredibly important task, then just how quickly that confidence disappears when your surrounded by smouldering heat, bubbling molten lava flowing around you.$(br)I really should've brought extr-$(br)$(br)$(o)The entry ends here, the page burned slightly.

pages.title: It's HERE
pages.text: $(l)Entry 5$(br)$()I've found it! Cobalt, glistening so brightly next to the pooling lava! I perhaps prepared a bit too much for it's excavation, as it seems my initial attempt to break it with my $(l)Diamond Pickaxe$() has yielded no results, will test further...

pages.title: IRON, THAT'S THE KEY
pages.text: $(l)Entry 5.1$(br)$()Iron! It seems Cobalt is far too fragile in it's natural form and must be extracted with a tool less powerful, such as Iron! Not only this, but it seems to yield quite a substantial amount, making up for it's natural rarity! I better harvest as much as I can, $(k)don't want to travel back here for a while...
